snippet.title: Hack and Climb | Latin American Games Showcase TGA 2025 - Trailer
snippet.description:
You play as a cursed axe climbing out of the abyss in search of revenge against the wizard that cursed you.

*Gameplay is a mix between Flippy knife & Jump king.
